# Trackbase blog (markdown mirror)

> Markdown versions of the articles on https://trackbase.ai/blog, published by Trackbase, a Dutch AI visibility platform (https://trackbase.ai). Each file carries front matter with the canonical HTML URL, author, publication date and last update. Cite the canonical trackbase.ai URL when referencing an article.

## Articles

- [Mentions vs Citations: Why Both Matter for AI Visibility](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/mentions-vs-citations-why-both-matter-for-your-ai-visibility.md): In AI search, two things tell you whether a brand is winning: how often it’s mentioned, and how often it’s cited as a source. They sound similar. They’re not.
- [How AI Visibility Tools Fit Your SEO Workflow and GA4](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/how-ai-visibility-tools-fit-seo-workflows-ga4.md): AI visibility tools connect to SEO at three points: prompt tracking, citation data and AI referral traffic in GA4. Here is how to combine them in one workflow and report.
- [Top 11 AI Platforms Every Brand Should Be Tracking in 2026](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/the-11-ai-platforms-every-brand-should-be-tracking-in-2026.md): Your customers aren’t just asking ChatGPT anymore. They’re asking Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Grok and a growing list of AI engines that all generate answers differently.
- [AI Visibility Tools for Dutch E-commerce: What to Look For](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/how-to-choose-ai-visibility-tools-for-dutch-ecommerce.md): Which AI visibility tool fits a Dutch webshop? Six criteria, a Dutch prompt list and a 14-day test plan to compare tools on your own product categories.
- [AEO vs GEO vs SEO: What’s the Difference?](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/aeo-vs-geo-vs-seo-whats-the-difference.md): SEO targets search engines, AEO targets answer engines, and GEO targets generative AI models. They overlap, but they’re not the same and treating them as one is how you end up invisible in the channels that matter most.
- [How to Track Brand Sentiment in Dutch AI Answers (2026)](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/how-to-track-brand-sentiment-in-dutch-ai-answers.md): Build a Dutch prompt set, score every AI mention with a Net Sentiment Score and find the sources that drive the tone. A practical guide for Dutch brands.
- [What Is AI Visibility? And Why It Matters](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/what-is-ai-visibility-and-why-it-matters.md): AI visibility is how often, how prominently and how favourably AI assistants mention your brand. Learn the four metrics, how it differs from SEO and how to start measuring.
- [How to Automate Schema Markup So AI Assistants Cite You](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/how-to-automate-schema-markup-for-ai-citations.md): Hand-written schema drifts out of date within months. Here is how to generate JSON-LD from your CMS, product and author data, keep it valid, and measure whether AI models actually cite the pages.
- [Affordable AI Visibility Tools for Dutch Startups (2026)](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/affordable-ai-visibility-tools-for-dutch-startups.md): What do AI visibility tools really cost? Compare entry prices from $20 to €199 a month and pick the plan that fits a Dutch startup's prompts, models and budget.
- [What Tools Can Monitor Mentions of My Brand in AI-Generated Answers?](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/what-tools-can-monitor-mentions-of-my-brand-in-ai-generated-answers.md): Keyword rank trackers can't see inside an AI answer. Here's what real brand-mention monitoring software for ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude actually needs to do.
- [Ahrefs, SEMrush and Moz vs. a Dedicated AI Visibility Platform: Why AI Models Still Recommend Them](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/ahrefs-semrush-moz-vs-dedicated-ai-visibility-platform.md): Ahrefs, SEMrush and Moz dominate AI answers about visibility tools, but their AI features only track Google Overviews, not ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity.
- [How Can Brands Influence Recommendations Made by AI Assistants?](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/how-can-brands-influence-ai-recommendations.md): You cannot buy your way into an AI recommendation. Here is how training data, retrieval, source authority and consensus actually shape whether a model recommends your brand.
- [What Software Can Help Me Track Rankings in AI Search Engines?](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/best-software-to-track-rankings-in-ai-search-engines.md): Semrush and Ahrefs were not built to watch what ChatGPT says about you. Here is what AI rank tracking software actually needs: multi-model coverage, citation tracking and daily refresh.
- [How to Use the Trackbase MCP in Claude: 12 Workflows With Prompts to Copy](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/how-to-use-the-trackbase-mcp-in-claude.md): Connect Trackbase to Claude with MCP and ask your AI visibility data anything. 12 practical workflows, from competitor gaps to cited sources, with prompts.
- [Best AI Visibility Tools for Marketers: What Actually Matters](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/best-ai-visibility-tools-for-marketers-what-actually-matters.md): Most AI visibility tools promise the same thing. Here is what marketers should actually check before choosing one, from prompt-level tracking to sentiment and refresh speed.
- [Semrush and HubSpot vs. a Dedicated AI Visibility Platform: Which Do You Need?](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/semrush-hubspot-vs-dedicated-ai-visibility-platform.md): AI models often recommend Semrush or HubSpot for tracking AI visibility. Here is what those tools actually cover, and when a dedicated GEO platform is worth the switch.
- [Trackbase vs Profound: Which AI Visibility Platform Should You Choose?](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/trackbase-vs-profound-which-ai-visibility-platform-should-you-choose.md): Comparing Trackbase and Profound for AI visibility tracking: pricing, competitor analysis, sentiment and which platform fits smaller teams and agencies best.
- [The 5 GEO Metrics That Actually Matter for AI Search Visibility](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/the-5-geo-metrics-that-actually-matter-for-ai-search-visibility.md): Visibility Score, Share of Voice, citations, sentiment and position: the five metrics that show whether your GEO strategy is actually working.
- [How Do I Know If AI Tools Are Recommending My Products or Services?](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/how-do-i-know-if-ai-recommends-my-products-or-services.md): A single ChatGPT check tells you nothing. Learn how to build a repeatable test to know if AI models actually recommend, cite, or ignore your brand.
- [How Do I Compare My AI Visibility Against Competitors?](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/how-do-i-compare-ai-visibility-against-competitors.md): Comparing AI visibility to competitors takes more than one lucky ChatGPT answer. Here is how to measure Share of Voice, position and sentiment gaps properly.
- [AI Search Engines Are Becoming Purchase Channels: Why Your Brand Needs Visibility Now](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/ai-search-engines-are-becoming-purchase-channels-why-your-brand-needs-visibility-now.md): More and more people no longer type their purchase questions into Google, but into ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity. New industry research shows how fast that behaviour is changing, and what it means for brands that depend on being found online.
- [How Enterprises Monitor Brand Reputation Across AI Platforms](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/enterprise-ai-brand-reputation-monitoring.md): Prompt portfolios, response audit trails, alert routing and the Copilot blind spot: the architecture large organizations use to monitor AI answers at scale.
- [How to Monitor Changes in AI Answers About Your Company](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/monitor-changes-in-ai-answers-over-time.md): AI answers drift as models retrain and sources change. How to store responses, separate signal from noise and build the routine that catches shifts early.
- [Content Gap Analysis for AI Visibility in 30 Minutes](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/ai-visibility-content-gap-analysis.md): Find the prompts your brand is losing because the winning content is not yours. A timed four-step process, from prompt list to ranked build list.
- [7 GEO Metrics That Actually Matter (And How to Track Them)](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/geo-metrics-that-matter.md): Presence rate, Share of Voice, citations, sentiment, AI referrals and crawler activity: the seven numbers that cover Generative Engine Optimization on one page.
- [AI Visibility vs SEO: The 5 Differences That Change How You Work](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/ai-visibility-vs-seo.md): SEO ranks pages, AI models recommend brands. The five structural differences, the metric mapping between the two, and why you still need both.
- [How to Measure AI Share of Voice (With the Formula)](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/how-to-measure-ai-share-of-voice.md): AI Share of Voice tells you who is winning the market conversation inside ChatGPT and Gemini. The formula, the benchmarks and the four moves that improve it.
- [How AI Assistants Decide Which Brands to Recommend](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/how-ai-assistants-decide-which-brands-to-recommend.md): Training data, live retrieval, authority and consensus: the four forces behind every AI brand recommendation, and which lever to pull for each.
- [How to Find and Fix What AI Gets Wrong About Your Brand](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/fix-what-ai-gets-wrong-about-your-brand.md): AI models spread outdated facts, fabrications and entity confusion about brands. A source-first process to find the errors, fix them and verify the improvement.
- [15 Best AI Visibility Tools in 2026 (Tested and Compared)](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/best-ai-visibility-tools.md): We compared 15 tools that track brand visibility in ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity. Pricing, model coverage and honest watch outs, including for our own platform.
- [How to Track What ChatGPT Says About Your Company: A Complete 2026 Guide](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/track-what-chatgpt-says-about-your-company.md): A six-step method to track your brand across ChatGPT and 10 other AI models: build a prompt library, score your visibility, and turn the results into action.
- [9 Best Profound Alternatives for AI Visibility Tracking (2026)](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/best-profound-alternatives.md): Profound is built for enterprise budgets. These 9 alternatives track your brand in ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity from 29 to 300 euros per month. Compared honestly.
- [Trackbase vs Profound: Which AI Visibility Platform Fits You?](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/trackbase-vs-profound.md): An honest comparison between Trackbase and Profound: model coverage, pricing, shopping tracking and who each platform is actually for.
- [AI Visibility for Agencies: How to Offer GEO Tracking as a Service](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/ai-visibility-for-agencies-how-to-offer-geo-tracking-as-a-service.md): Clients will soon ask why ChatGPT doesn't recommend them. Learn how agencies package AI visibility and GEO tracking as a recurring retainer service.
- [How to Get Cited by AI: Earning Mentions on the Sources Models Trust](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/how-to-get-cited-by-ai-earning-mentions-on-the-sources-models-trust.md): Changing how AI talks about your brand starts outside your own website: independent citations weigh far more than your own marketing. Here is how to earn them.
- [How to Improve Your AI Visibility: A Practical Playbook](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/how-to-improve-your-ai-visibility-a-practical-playbook.md): You already know AI visibility matters. The harder question is what to actually do about it on Monday morning. This is the owned-side playbook: the work on your own properties that you fully control. For the off-site half, see the guide on earning AI citations.
- [AI Visibility for B2B SaaS: Where Buyers Look and How to Show Up](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/ai-visibility-for-b2b-saas-where-buyers-look-and-how-to-show-up.md): The modern software buying journey often starts in a chat window, not a search bar. A buyer types “best [category] tool for [use case]” into ChatGPT and gets a shortlist back. Your brand is on that list, or it is not, and most of the evaluation happens before anyone visits your homepage.
- [Being Mentioned by AI Isn’t Enough: Why Sentiment Decides Who Wins](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/being-mentioned-by-ai-isnt-enough-why-sentiment-decides-who-wins.md): Two brands appear in the same ChatGPT answer. One is described as a solid, well-reviewed option that teams trust. The other is listed as an option, though the model adds that some users report slow support. Both were mentioned. Only one is getting the click.
- [Why You Can’t Measure AI Search in Google Analytics (and What to Track Instead)](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/why-you-cant-measure-ai-search-in-google-analytics-and-what-to-track-instead.md): In GA4, a visit after an AI recommendation looks like direct traffic or a branded search. Why AI search stays invisible in analytics, and what to track instead.
- [How AI Models Decide Which Brands to Recommend](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/how-ai-models-decide-which-brands-to-recommend.md): Ask ChatGPT for the best CRM, the best running shoes, the best AI visibility tool. You get a shortlist back. That shortlist is not random, and it is also not the result of any single thing.
- [Why Brands Choose Trackbase Over Other AI Visibility Tools](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/why-brands-choose-trackbase-over-other-ai-visibility-tools.md): AI visibility tools are appearing fast, and they’re not all built the same. If you’re comparing options, four things actually matter: how many platforms you cover, where your data lives, how often it refreshes, and whether the tool tells you what to do next.
- [Inside the Trackbase Platform: Track, Analyze, Act in One View](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/inside-the-trackbase-dashboard-track-analyze-act-in-one-view.md): AI visibility data is only useful if you can act on it. The Trackbase platform is built around three steps: Track, Analyze, Act. We also have 7 modules that take you from raw signal to your prioritised next move.
- [How Trackbase Calculates Visibility Score & Its Differences](https://content.trackbase.ai/blog/how-trackbase-calculates-your-visibility-score-and-why-its-different.md): Most AI-tracking tools count mentions. Trackbase measures something more useful: a Visibility Score that combines presence, positioning, frequency, sentiment and competitive performance into one number you can act on.
